WITH cand AS (
    SELECT
        sc.school,
        sc.gsserved,
        CASE
            WHEN split_part(sc.gsserved, '-', 1) = 'PK' THEN -1
            WHEN split_part(sc.gsserved, '-', 1) = 'K' THEN 0
            ELSE CAST(split_part(sc.gsserved, '-', 1) AS integer)
        END AS start_grade
    FROM schools sc
    LEFT JOIN satscores sat
        ON sat.cds = sc.cdscode
    WHERE sc.ncesdist = '0613360'
      AND sc.statustype = 'Active'
      AND sc.school IS NOT NULL
      AND split_part(sc.gsserved, '-', 2) = '12'
      AND (split_part(sc.gsserved, '-', 1) IN ('PK', 'K')
           OR split_part(sc.gsserved, '-', 1) ~ '^[0-9]+$')
      AND COALESCE(sat.numtsttakr, 0) = 0
)
SELECT school, gsserved
FROM cand
WHERE start_grade = (SELECT MIN(start_grade) FROM cand)
ORDER BY school

WITH public_schools AS (
    SELECT cdscode, district, admfname1 AS fname
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cdscode, district, admfname2 AS fname
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cdscode, district, admfname3 AS fname
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT fname
    FROM (
        SELECT fname, COUNT(DISTINCT cdscode) AS school_cnt
        FROM public_schools
        WHERE fname IS NOT NULL AND fname <> ''
        GROUP BY fname
        ORDER BY school_cnt DESC, fname ASC
        LIMIT 2
    ) ranked
),
public_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district
    FROM schools
    WHERE county IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND doctype IN ('Unified School District', 'Elementary School District',
                      'High School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
      AND district IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.district AS "District Name",
       t.fname AS "First Name",
       COUNT(DISTINCT ps.cdscode) AS "School Count"
FROM public_districts d
CROSS JOIN top_names t
LEFT JOIN public_schools ps
       ON ps.district = d.district
      AND ps.fname = t.fname
GROUP BY d.district, t.fname
ORDER BY d.district, t.fname

SELECT
    s.fundingtype AS funding_category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count,
    SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS total_enrollment_2014_2015,
    ROUND((AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)") * 100)::numeric, 2) AS avg_frpm_percent,
    ROUND(AVG(sat.combined_sat)::numeric, 2) AS avg_combined_sat

    ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

    SELECT cds, (avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite) AS combined_sat

) sat
    ON sat.cds = s.cdscode

  AND s.statustype = 'Active'
  AND s.fundingtype IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
GROUP BY s.fundingtype

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.cdscode,
        s.school,
        s.charter,
        s.gsserved,
        SUM(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)")::numeric / SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)")::numeric AS rate
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
    WHERE s.county = 'Alameda'
      AND s.gsserved LIKE '%-12'
      AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
    GROUP BY s.cdscode, s.school, s.charter, s.gsserved
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT b.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY b.rate DESC) AS rk
    FROM base b
)
SELECT
    r.school AS "School Name",
    ROUND(r.rate, 4) AS "Free Meal Rate",
    CASE
        WHEN r.charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN r.charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS "Charter School",
    r.gsserved AS "Grades Served",
    CASE
        WHEN sc.avgscrread IS NULL OR sc.avgscrmath IS NULL OR sc.avgscrwrite IS NULL
            THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN (sc.avgscrread + sc.avgscrmath + sc.avgscrwrite) < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN (sc.avgscrread + sc.avgscrmath + sc.avgscrwrite) <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS "SAT Performance Level"
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN satscores sc ON sc.cds = r.cdscode
WHERE r.rk = 1
ORDER BY r.school

WITH virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT s.cdscode, s.county, s.school
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.virtual = 'F'
    AND s.county IS NOT NULL
),
county_counts AS (
  SELECT county, COUNT(*) AS virtual_count
  FROM virtual_schools
  GROUP BY county
),
ranked_counties AS (
  SELECT county, virtual_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY virtual_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM county_counts
),
top_counties AS (
  SELECT county, virtual_count
  FROM ranked_counties
  WHERE rnk <= 5
),
school_scores AS (
  SELECT v.county, v.school, sat.avgscrread
  FROM virtual_schools v
  JOIN top_counties t ON t.county = v.county
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = v.cdscode
),
max_scores AS (
  SELECT county, MAX(avgscrread) AS max_read
  FROM school_scores
  GROUP BY county
),
best_schools AS (
  SELECT ss.county, ss.school
  FROM school_scores ss
  JOIN max_scores m
    ON m.county = ss.county
   AND ss.avgscrread = m.max_read
)
SELECT t.county AS "County Name",
       t.virtual_count AS "Virtual School Count",
       COALESCE(b.school, 'None') AS "School Name"
FROM top_counties t
LEFT JOIN best_schools b ON b.county = t.county
ORDER BY t.virtual_count DESC, t.county, b.school

WITH target AS (
    SELECT county
    FROM schools
    WHERE cdscode = LPAD('1612590125716', 14, '0')
),
sel AS (
    SELECT
        f.cdscode,
        f."Charter School (Y/N)",
        ROUND(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)"::numeric / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)"::numeric, 0) * 100, 2) AS free_pct,

    FROM frpm f

      AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
)

    ROUND(AVG(s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite), 2) AS avg_sat_total

GROUP BY t.county

WITH sch AS (
  SELECT s.*,
         f."Enrollment (K-12)"        AS enroll,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)"        AS frpm_cnt,
         f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS frpm_share
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
),
elig AS (
  SELECT * FROM sch
  WHERE charter = 0 AND enroll > 100
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT cdscode, 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, 1 AS ord
  FROM elig
  WHERE frpm_cnt = (SELECT MAX(frpm_cnt) FROM elig)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cdscode, 'smallest FRPM share', 2
  FROM elig
  WHERE frpm_share = (SELECT MIN(frpm_share) FROM elig)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cdscode, 'the CDS code from my notes', 3
  FROM sch
  WHERE cdscode = '04615150435602'
)
SELECT sc.school            AS "School Name",
       sc.county            AS "County",
       sc.city              AS "City",
       sc.mailstreet        AS "Mailing Street",
       sc.mailcity          AS "Mailing City",
       sc.mailstate         AS "Mailing State",
       sc.mailzip           AS "Mailing ZIP",
       sc.website           AS "Website",
       sc.enroll            AS "K-12 Enrollment",
       sc.frpm_cnt          AS "FRPM-Eligible Count",
       sc.frpm_share        AS "FRPM Share",
       (sat.avgscrread + sat.avgscrmath + sat.avgscrwrite) AS "Average SAT Total",
       CASE WHEN sat.numtsttakr > 0
            THEN 100.0 * sat.numge1500 / sat.numtsttakr
       END                  AS "Pct SAT Takers 1500+",
       sc.opendate          AS "Open Date",
       CASE WHEN sc.closeddate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS "Status",
       l.part               AS "Part"
FROM labeled l
JOIN sch sc ON sc.cdscode = l.cdscode
LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = sc.cdscode
ORDER BY l.ord, sc.cdscode

    SELECT owneruserid AS userid
    FROM posts
    WHERE creaiondate >= '2012-01-01'
      AND creaiondate <  '2013-01-01'
      AND owneruserid IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY owneruserid
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
upvotes_per_user AS (
    SELECT a.userid,
           COUNT(v.id) AS upvote_count
    FROM active_users a
    LEFT JOIN votes v
           ON v.userid = a.userid
          AND v.votetypeid = 2
    GROUP BY a.userid
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.upvote_count)::numeric, 2) AS avg_upvotes,
       ROUND(AVG(us.age)::numeric, 2)         AS avg_age
FROM upvotes_per_user u
JOIN users us ON us.id = u.userid

  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM pl.creationdate)::int AS m,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS cnt

  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(mo.cnt, 0))::numeric / 12, 2) AS avg_monthly_posts
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly mo ON mo.m = m.m

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT c.segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2012%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS c2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN y.date LIKE '2013%' THEN y.consumption ELSE 0 END)::numeric AS c2013
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON y.customerid = c.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT segment,
         ROUND(((c2013 - c2012) / c2012 * 100), 2) AS increase_pct
  FROM seg
  WHERE c2012 <> 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT segment,
         increase_pct,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY increase_pct DESC) AS rk_desc,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY increase_pct ASC)  AS rk_asc
  FROM pct
)
SELECT segment, increase_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE rk_desc = 1 OR rk_asc = 1

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.customerid,
         c.segment,
         SUM(y.consumption::numeric) AS total
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth y ON y.customerid = c.customerid
  WHERE c.currency = 'CZK'
    AND c.segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND y.date LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY c.customerid, c.segment
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT segment,
         total,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total ASC, customerid ASC) AS rn
  FROM totals
),
lowest AS (
  SELECT segment, total
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN total END)
       - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN total END))::numeric, 2) AS sme_minus_lam,
  ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'LAM' THEN total END)
       - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN total END))::numeric, 2) AS lam_minus_kam,
  ROUND((MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'KAM' THEN total END)
       - MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SME' THEN total END))::numeric, 2) AS kam_minus_sme
FROM lowest

WITH risky AS (

  FROM team_attributes ta
  WHERE ta.chancecreationpassingclass = 'Risky'

eligible AS (
  SELECT t.team_api_id, t.team_short_name

WITH home_wins AS (
  SELECT m.id AS match_id,
         m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
         m.date AS match_date
  FROM match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),
fast_wins AS (
  SELECT hw.team_api_id, hw.match_id
  FROM home_wins hw
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ta.buildupplayspeedclass
    FROM team_attributes ta
    WHERE ta.team_api_id = hw.team_api_id
      AND ta.date <= hw.match_date
    ORDER BY ta.date DESC, ta.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) s ON TRUE
  WHERE s.buildupplayspeedclass = 'Fast'
),
win_counts AS (
  SELECT t.team_api_id,
         t.team_long_name,
         t.team_short_name,
         COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM fast_wins fw
  JOIN team t ON t.team_api_id = fw.team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, t.team_short_name
)
SELECT team_long_name, team_short_name, wins
FROM win_counts
WHERE wins = (SELECT MAX(wins) FROM win_counts)

FROM ranked

WITH prach_accts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opening_date
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE d.a2 = 'Prachatice'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loan l WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id)
),
loans AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM prach_accts)
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
cp AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS counterparties
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    AND t.account <> 0
    AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM prach_accts)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
owner AS (
  SELECT ds.account_id, c.district_id AS home_district_id
  FROM disp ds
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = ds.client_id
  WHERE ds.type = 'OWNER'
),
base AS (
  SELECT p.account_id,
         p.opening_date,
         l.total_borrowed,
         COALESCE(cp.counterparties, 0) AS counterparties,
         o.home_district_id,
         CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) AS population
  FROM prach_accts p
  JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = p.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cp ON cp.account_id = p.account_id
  JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = p.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = o.home_district_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opening_date,
       total_borrowed,
       counterparties,
       home_district_id,
       population,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY population DESC) AS rnk
FROM base
ORDER BY population DESC, account_id

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         cl.gender,
         d.district_id,
         d.a2,
         d.a4::bigint AS inhabitants,
         d.a10,
         d.a11
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d0      ON d0.disp_id = c.disp_id
  JOIN disp dp      ON dp.account_id = d0.account_id AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client cl    ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN account a    ON a.account_id = d0.account_id
  JOIN district d   ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'
    AND cl.gender IN ('F', 'M')
    AND d.a4::bigint > 100000
    AND a.account_id IN (
          SELECT t.account_id
          FROM trans t
          GROUP BY t.account_id
          HAVING AVG(t.balance) > 1000
        )
),
stats AS (
  SELECT gender,
         COUNT(*)                        AS num_districts,
         ROUND(AVG(a11)::numeric, 2)     AS avg_salary,
         ROUND(AVG(a10)::numeric, 2)     AS avg_urban_ratio
  FROM base
  GROUP BY gender
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.gender ORDER BY b.inhabitants DESC) AS rk
  FROM base b
)
SELECT s.gender,
       s.num_districts,
       r.a2 AS top_district,
       r.inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM stats s
JOIN ranked r ON r.gender = s.gender AND r.rk = 1
ORDER BY CASE s.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, r.a2

WITH top3 AS (
    SELECT
        d.a2 AS district_name,
        d.a16 AS crimes_1996,
        CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) AS inhabitants
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.a3 = 'central Bohemia'
    ORDER BY
        CAST(d.a4 AS bigint) DESC,
        translate(d.a2,
            'áčďéěíňóřšťúůýžÁČĎÉĚÍŇÓŘŠŤÚŮÝŽ',
            'acdeeinorstuuyzACDEEINORSTUUYZ') ASC
    LIMIT 3
),
top_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(crimes_1996) AS avg_top
    FROM top3
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(a16) AS avg_all
    FROM district
)
SELECT
    t.district_name,
    t.crimes_1996,
    ROUND(ta.avg_top::numeric, 2) AS three_district_avg,
    ROUND(o.avg_all::numeric, 2) AS overall_avg,
    ROUND((ta.avg_top - o.avg_all)::numeric, 2) AS difference
FROM top3 t
CROSS JOIN top_avg ta

ORDER BY
    t.inhabitants DESC,

WITH reg AS (
  SELECT a3
  FROM district
  WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'
),
acc96 AS (
  SELECT account_id, district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND date < DATE '1997-01-01'
),
last_tx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (account_id) account_id, balance
  FROM trans
  WHERE date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  ORDER BY account_id, date DESC, trans_id DESC
),
base AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, a.account_id, lt.balance
  FROM acc96 a
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN reg r ON d.a3 = r.a3
  LEFT JOIN last_tx lt ON lt.account_id = a.account_id
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT district_name,
         COUNT(*) AS num_accounts,
         ROUND(AVG(balance)::numeric, 2) AS avg_balance
  FROM base
  GROUP BY district_id, district_name
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance)::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_balance
  FROM base
),
top_district AS (
  SELECT district_name
  FROM district_stats
  ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ds.district_name,
       ds.num_accounts,
       ds.avg_balance,
       rs.region_avg_balance,
       td.district_name AS top_district
FROM district_stats ds
CROSS JOIN region_stats rs
CROSS JOIN top_district td
ORDER BY ds.district_name

  FROM acc96 a

),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT district_name,

region_stats AS (

top_district AS (

FROM district_stats ds

CROSS JOIN top_district td
ORDER BY ds.district_name

WITH withdrawals AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount)::numeric AS standing_total
  FROM "order" o
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
acct AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count
  FROM account
  GROUP BY district_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    d.a2 AS district_name,
    d.a3 AS region,
    d.a4::bigint AS population,
    w.total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(w.total_withdrawn::numeric / d.a4::bigint, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    ROUND(COALESCE(s.standing_total, 0) / ac.account_count, 2) AS avg_standing_order_per_account
  FROM district d
  JOIN withdrawals w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN acct ac ON ac.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN standing s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
)
SELECT
  district_name,
  region,
  population,
  total_withdrawn,
  withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_rank,
  avg_standing_order_per_account
FROM base
ORDER BY withdrawal_rank, district_name

  GROUP BY d.a3

  SELECT
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount END), 0) AS total_expense
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM client_accounts)
  GROUP BY account_id
)

  a.account_id,

  a.frequency,
  dr.a2 AS district_name,
  dr.a3 AS region,

  COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_status,
  COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
  COALESCE(t.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  COALESCE(t.total_income, 0) AS total_income,

  COALESCE(rc.client_count, 0) AS region_client_count,

WITH loan_stats AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
         SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan
  GROUP BY account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT c.client_id,
         c.gender,
         c.birth_date,
         cd.type AS card_type,
         (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cd.issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date))::int AS age_at_issue,
         COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         COALESCE(ls.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount,
         d.a2 AS district_name,
         d.a11 AS district_avg_salary
  FROM card cd
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_stats ls ON ls.account_id = dp.account_id
  LEFT JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  WHERE cd.issued >= DATE '1994-01-01'
    AND cd.issued <  DATE '1995-01-01'
)

       birth_date,
       card_type,
       age_at_issue,
       loan_count,
       total_amount,

         WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
         ELSE 'Non-borrower'
       END AS borrower_classification,
       district_name,
       district_avg_salary,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY gender ORDER BY age_at_issue DESC) AS age_rank_within_gender
FROM base

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp d    ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ'  THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
           COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                 WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.bank <> ''
                  AND t.account IS NOT NULL AND t.account <> 0
                 THEN t.bank || '|' || t.account::text
           END) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_agg AS (
    SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
    GROUP BY l.account_id
)
SELECT g.account_id,
       di.a2 AS district_name,
       di.a3 AS region,
       COALESCE(t.total_received, 0)        AS total_received,
       COALESCE(t.total_withdrawn, 0)       AS total_withdrawn,
       COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0)           AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(t.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (
           ORDER BY COALESCE(t.external_counterparties, 0) DESC
       ) AS external_rank
FROM gold_accounts g
JOIN district di       ON di.district_id = g.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg t  ON t.account_id = g.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg la  ON la.account_id = g.account_id
ORDER BY external_rank, g.account_id

)
SELECT g.account_id,
       di.a2 AS district_name,
       di.a3 AS region,
       COALESCE(t.total_received, 0)        AS total_received,
       COALESCE(t.total_withdrawn, 0)       AS total_withdrawn,
       COALESCE(la.loan_count, 0)           AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(t.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (
           ORDER BY COALESCE(t.external_counterparties, 0) DESC
       ) AS external_rank
FROM gold_accounts g
JOIN district di       ON di.district_id = g.district_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg t  ON t.account_id = g.account_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg la  ON la.account_id = g.account_id
ORDER BY external_rank, g.account_id

  FROM female_loans f
),
top_loans AS (
  SELECT * FROM ranked_loans WHERE rnk <= 3
),

  SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans t
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
region_loans AS (
  SELECT d.a3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a  ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY d.a3
),
region_salary AS (
  SELECT d.a3 AS region, AVG(d.a11) AS avg_salary
  FROM district d

  tl.client_id,
  tl.amount AS loan_amount,
  tl.duration AS duration_months,
  ROUND(CAST(tl.payments AS numeric) * tl.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND(CAST(tl.payments AS numeric) * tl.duration - tl.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
  tl.status AS loan_status,
  tl.district_name AS district,
  tl.region,
  COALESCE(ta.trans_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  COALESCE(ta.total_deposits, 0) AS total_deposits,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ta.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * tl.amount THEN 'High Income'
    WHEN COALESCE(ta.total_deposits, 0) > tl.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
    ELSE 'Low Income'

  rl.loan_count AS region_loan_count,
  ROUND(CAST(rs.avg_salary AS numeric), 2) AS region_avg_salary,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', tl.birth_date))::int AS client_age
FROM top_loans tl

LEFT JOIN region_loans rl ON rl.region = tl.region
LEFT JOIN region_salary rs ON rs.region = tl.region
ORDER BY tl.amount DESC

WITH owner_classic AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id, d.client_id
  FROM disp d
  JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.type = 'classic'
),
client_stats AS (
  SELECT a.district_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oc.client_id) AS client_count
  FROM owner_classic oc
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
payment_stats AS (
  SELECT a.district_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account))
           FILTER (WHERE t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL) AS external_account_count,
         SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM owner_classic)
  GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT d.a2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(cs.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
       COALESCE(ps.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
       COALESCE(ps.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN client_stats cs ON cs.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN payment_stats ps ON ps.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC

WITH tabor_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened
  FROM account a
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE d.a2 = 'Tabor'
),
owner AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dp.account_id)
         dp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp dp
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
  ORDER BY dp.account_id, dp.disp_id
),
card_cnt AS (
  SELECT dp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM card cd
  JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  WHERE cd.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
loan_agg AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         BOOL_OR(status = 'B') AS has_b,
         BOOL_OR(status IN ('C', 'D')) AS has_cd
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
trans97 AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS n_tx,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS money_in,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN amount END), 0) AS money_out,
         MAX(balance) AS peak
  FROM trans
  WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
profile AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         t.opened,
         o.gender,
         DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS age,
         COALESCE(cc.n, 0) AS card_count,
         COALESCE(la.n, 0) AS loan_count,
         CASE
           WHEN la.n IS NULL THEN 'no loan'
           WHEN la.has_b THEN 'defaulted'
           WHEN la.has_cd THEN 'repaying'
           ELSE 'paid off'
         END AS loan_standing,
         COALESCE(tx.n_tx, 0) AS trans_count,
         COALESCE(tx.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
         COALESCE(tx.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
         COALESCE(tx.peak, 0) AS peak_balance
  FROM tabor_accounts t
  LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN card_cnt cc ON cc.account_id = t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON la.account_id = t.account_id
  LEFT JOIN trans97 tx ON tx.account_id = t.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opened,
       gender,
       age,
       card_count,
       loan_count,
       loan_standing,
       trans_count,
       money_in,
       money_out,
       peak_balance,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS peak_rank
FROM profile
ORDER BY peak_rank, account_id

WITH race_starts AS (
  SELECT c.circuitref, r.time::time AS start_time
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitid = r.circuitid
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL AND r.time <> ''
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT MIN(start_time) AS min_t, MAX(start_time) AS max_t
  FROM race_starts
),
earliest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT rs.circuitref
  FROM race_starts rs
  JOIN bounds b ON rs.start_time = b.min_t
),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT rs.circuitref
  FROM race_starts rs
  JOIN bounds b ON rs.start_time = b.max_t
)
SELECT e.circuitref AS earliest_circuitref,
       l.circuitref AS latest_circuitref,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (b.max_t - b.min_t))::bigint AS gap_seconds
FROM earliest e
CROSS JOIN latest l
CROSS JOIN bounds b

WITH best AS (
  SELECT r.driverid,
         MAX(CAST(r.fastestlapspeed AS real)) AS max_speed
  FROM results r
  WHERE r.fastestlapspeed ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
  GROUP BY r.driverid
)

FROM best b
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverid = b.driverid
WHERE d.dob >= DATE '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob <  DATE '1991-01-01'
ORDER BY b.max_speed DESC, d.dob ASC, d.surname ASC
LIMIT 3

  SELECT event_id
  FROM event
  WHERE substring(event_date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
),
fall_counts AS (
  SELECT fe.event_id, COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS cnt
  FROM fall_events fe
  LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = fe.event_id
  GROUP BY fe.event_id
),
soccer AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS cnt
  FROM event e
  JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
),
avg_fall AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(cnt)::numeric, 1) AS avg_att
  FROM fall_counts
)
SELECT
  s.cnt AS womens_soccer_attendance,
  af.avg_att AS avg_fall_2019_attendance,
  CASE
    WHEN s.cnt > af.avg_att THEN 'more'
    WHEN s.cnt < af.avg_att THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
FROM soccer s
CROSS JOIN avg_fall af

WITH hss_depts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department
  FROM major
  WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
dept_majors AS (
  SELECT m.department, m.major_id
  FROM major m
  JOIN hss_depts h ON m.department = h.department
),
major_member_counts AS (
  SELECT dm.department, dm.major_id, COUNT(mem.member_id) AS member_count
  FROM dept_majors dm
  LEFT JOIN member mem ON mem.link_to_major = dm.major_id
  GROUP BY dm.department, dm.major_id
)
SELECT
  department,
  COUNT(*) AS majors_offered,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE member_count > 0) AS majors_held,
  ROUND(SUM(member_count)::numeric / COUNT(*), 2) AS avg_members_per_major
FROM major_member_counts
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY department

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.id
    FROM patient p
    JOIN examination e ON e.id = p.id
    WHERE p.sex = 'F'
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT l.id,
           CASE
               WHEN lower(trim(l.rnp)) = 'negative' THEN 0::numeric
               WHEN trim(l.rnp) ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(l.rnp)::numeric
               ELSE NULL
           END AS titer
    FROM laboratory l
    JOIN cohort c ON c.id = l.id
),
per_patient AS (
    SELECT id, MAX(titer) AS max_titer
    FROM parsed
    GROUP BY id
    HAVING COUNT(titer) > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(
           100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE max_titer > 64) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
           2
       ) AS pct_elevated_anti_rnp
FROM per_patient

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.id,
         CASE p.admission
           WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
           WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
         END AS care_setting
  FROM patient p
  WHERE p.sex = 'F'
    AND p.birthday <= DATE '2026-10-09' - INTERVAL '50 years'
    AND p.admission IN ('+', '-')
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT e.care_setting,
         EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM laboratory l
           WHERE l.id = e.id
             AND (CASE WHEN l.rnp ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$' THEN l.rnp::numeric END) >= 4
         ) AS has_high_rnp
  FROM eligible e
)
SELECT care_setting,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_high_rnp) AS patients_with_high_rnp,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_high_rnp) AS patients_without_high_rnp
FROM flagged
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting

  FROM plus_atoms p

)

        / (SELECT total_atoms FROM total), 2) AS percentage
FROM top_elements t

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT molecule_id
        FROM atom
        WHERE UPPER(element) = 'Y'
      )
  AND (UPPER(a1.element) = 'H' OR UPPER(a2.element) = 'H')

       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b      ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m  ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom a1     ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2     ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
  AND a1.element = 'c'
GROUP BY a2.element

SELECT b.bond_type AS bond_kind,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT LEAST(a1.element, a2.element) || '-' || GREATEST(a1.element, a2.element)) AS element_pair_count,
       m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_kind ASC

sql:
WITH carbon_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE lower(element) = 'c'
),
atom_counts AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS atom_count,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(a.element) = 'c')  AS carbon_count,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(a.element) = 'cl') AS chlorine_count
  FROM atom a
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM bond b
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
carbon_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id,
         COUNT(*) AS carbon_bond_count
  FROM bond b
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    WHERE c.bond_id = b.bond_id
      AND (lower(a1.element) = 'c' OR lower(a2.element) = 'c')
  )
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),
inventory AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         m.label,
         COALESCE(ac.atom_count, 0)        AS atom_count,
         COALESCE(bc.bond_count, 0)        AS bond_count,
         COALESCE(ac.carbon_count, 0)      AS carbon_count,
         COALESCE(ac.chlorine_count, 0)    AS chlorine_count,
         COALESCE(cb.carbon_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_bond_count,
         COALESCE(bc.multiple_bond_count, 0) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM molecule m
  JOIN carbon_molecules cm ON cm.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN atom_counts ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN carbon_bonds cb ON cb.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (
         ORDER BY carbon_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC
       ) AS rank,
       molecule_id,
       label,
       atom_count,
       bond_count,
       carbon_count,
       chlorine_count,
       carbon_bond_count,
       multiple_bond_count
FROM inventory
ORDER BY carbon_bond_count DESC, atom_count DESC, molecule_id ASC

sql:
WITH bonded AS (
  SELECT c.atom_id AS atom_id, b.bond_type
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id, b.bond_type
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
),
saturated AS (
  SELECT atom_id
  FROM bonded
  GROUP BY atom_id
  HAVING BOOL_AND(bond_type = '-')
)
SELECT e.element,
       COUNT(s.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT element FROM atom) e
LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.element = e.element
LEFT JOIN saturated s ON s.atom_id = a.atom_id
GROUP BY e.element
ORDER BY e.element
